description: Maya Auchincloss from Toronto has decided to amputate her foot after battling cancer and dealing with excruciating pain since childhood. After several surgeries, the removal of a myofibroma, and lingering pain, she was diagnosed with a malignant glomus tumor. Since her diagnosis, doctors have done all they can, but her pain hasn’t gone away. Now that her amputation surgery is scheduled, she’s spent the last year checking items off her “F** it” list and has been saving up for a prosthetic foot. To donate to her GoFundMe, visit https://www.gofundme.com/f/fundraise-for-a-prosthetic-foot
title: Toronto Woman Crossing Items Off Her 'F** It' List Before Foot Amputation
